snippets.snippet_text: "Tiers are versions you can create within a membership. They can help you: Create varying levels of membership access, with each tier providing different combinations of content. Sell software with different license levels, like Individual or Team. Offer an additional service on top of your digital product, such as a coaching call or access to your community."
